judge.rationale: The core validation logic in `ToolRegistry` (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`) is very close to the reference implementation, using `ajv` with pre-compilation for static definitions and `WeakMap` caching for dynamic definitions. However, the candidate stopped mid-task, leaving `.lore/dod.md` and `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` in the tree, the latter of which the candidate's own notes admit fails `npm run eslint`. Furthermore, the candidate logs full Ajv error messages (`failures`), which risks leaking offending input values into logs on `enum` violations (unlike the reference which only logs `paths`), and uses `AjvModule.default` instead of the named `Ajv` export. Several explicit acceptance criteria were never completed: `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are untouched, the one-line JSDoc comment on `execute` is missing, and unit tests for extra properties, `Unknown tool` throws, and static compilation counts are absent from `registry.test.ts`.
